title: Checked-in client examples do not compile against current public headers
description:
The mount example, included by the examples all target, calls indigo_connect_server with four arguments although the header requires five. The older client.c also lacks standard-name declarations and passes integer descriptors to an adapter requiring indigo_uni_handle pointers. Exact compiler diagnostics are retained; this is distinct from FND-000010 unbounded connection handling. Fixed: Migrate client to current public headers and uni-handle adapter API; pass the fifth connect argument and include every example in the build.
